title: POWER TOASTS
description:
ENHANCED TOASTS 
Gather materials from nature to create special toasts. Discover the secret base in the bamboo forest and hunt living toasts with the hunter! Made by MCreator
body:
**IN THIS MODE** Special toasts, toast hunters and walking toasts. The game becomes more fun with special toasts (trick toast, tnt toast, fish toast and a few more) _Toasts and their power_ Fish Toast: You won't drown in water and you can swim faster. Cheat toast: After a creative (for a few seconds) from survival, you return to survival. Tnt toast: Explodes; Golden toast: Adds 10 more hearts and gives 1 resistance. 
Download the mod next!!!!
Created by:Mcreator
